title: Climate Pledge Arena, Seattle
visualBrief: The 1962 Washington State Coliseum roof preserved over the 2021 arena: a 400 ft square hyperbolic-paraboloid roof in four pale standing-seam quadrants between two dark cardinal truss ridges rising to the apex monitor and its Climate Pledge Arena signs; a broad white concrete edge beam sloping from each facade's centred three-legged abutment down to the low corners; the recessed glass curtain wall under the overhang with V-shaped piers; and the 2021 glass-and-solar south atrium.
scaleBasis: Measured: plan from the mapped footprint in footprint.json, heights from the sourced dimensions below.
geometrySource: Original deterministic Molen mesh generator models/generate-climate-pledge-arena.mjs; no third-party model or bitmap texture.

dimensions.fact: Plan: the mapped OSM building 35184397212588 with its roof part 35184783610349 (the 123 x 124 m square), glass base 35185724736644, truss strips 35185724754940-943, apex monitor 35184783610363, abutment legs 35185724755821-823 and south atrium parts 35185724736639-643
Hyperbolic paraboloid roof over a 400-foot-square column-free hall 115 feet high; post-tensioned concrete edge beams; four massive concrete abutments and V-shaped concrete piers

Four sets of three-legged abutments, one centred on each facade, carry the external edge beams and four triangular steel main trusses oriented to the cardinal directions; the glass curtain wall is recessed behind them beneath the overhanging roof; standing-seam aluminium roofing since 1995

12-foot-deep main trusses divide the 400-foot square into four quadrants on buttresses at the midpoints of each wall; diagonal trusses follow the drape of the original cable net; edge beams 30 feet wide
Roof 110 feet (11 stories) high on four massive concrete abutments, 4-acre site

2018-2021 redevelopment kept the 44-million-pound roof, curtain wall and exterior concrete elements; the roof was carried on temporary steel while the arena was excavated below it; south atrium added for the entrance

appearance.colorEncoding: sRGB palette decoded to linear COLOR_0

limitations: Roof heights are estimated: the apex from the 110-115 ft published height, the facade midpoints and low corners (about 13 m and 8 m above the plaza) from aerial photographs showing each facade edge falling from its abutment to the corners. The plaza datum is taken 3.5 m above the anchor because the explorer ground under the building is flattened to the arena floor.
Each roof quadrant is an exact bilinear hyperbolic paraboloid on a 16 x 16 grid; the diamond seam pattern, gutters and rooftop equipment are omitted.

The curtain wall is one glass face per bay with full-height mullions and two transoms; its alternating angled lites and the 1995 lower-level entrances are not modelled. The edge beam is a sloped fascia with a flat soffit.
The south abutment and the curtain wall inside the 2021 atrium are omitted; the atrium roof is simplified to solar and glazed bands on two folded planes.
Rooftop signs are block channel letters on a simple frame; the apex monitor is a plain louvered box.

Original deterministic geometry from mapped footprints, published dimensions and general knowledge of the building; not a survey, photogrammetric reconstruction or replica of any third-party model. No photographs or generated bitmaps are embedded.
